evidence.quote: as the first real life test of the regulatory framework erected after the global financial crisis (GFC), I believe it can tell us a lot about what is working and what aspects of our framework may need strengthening.
While the economy is recovering faster than we originally expected, and the financial sector returned pretty quickly to stable functioning
I am struck at the prominence of the continued need to focus on vulnerabilities associated with short-term funding.
tighter lending standards may make it difficult for some businesses and households to borrow during the pandemic.
